fusions.name: Skimmed Dart
fusions.desc: Throws a folded dart for 7 damage, rising to 2 times that at its maximum range of 7 tiles. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Kite Stoop
fusions.desc: You glide up to 7 tiles to the target and land on it, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Thousand-Fold Crane
fusions.desc: Folds a crane and lets it fly for 10 seconds. It pecks an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage every second, each peck with a 30% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Airmail
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, a leaflet dives at the nearest enemy within 6 tiles for 7 damage. Once every 4 seconds.
